changes:
Aurora's Apple Silicon PipeWire and WirePlumber DSP profiles (its asahi-audio fork), including the MacBook Neo (J700), with the legacy speaker graphs restored for the protection that keeps the speakers until a switch to speakerguardd v2. MCA speaker PCMs and the J616's wake on period interrupts. Pulls the whole speaker protection stack, as alarm-aurora's aurora-audio does, and replaces Debian's asahi-audio.
The legacy speaker protection (speakersafetyd, speakerguardd 0.1) is deprecated and will be removed; speakerguardd v2 is opt in through aurora-speaker-upgrade, and the description says so.
notes: alarm-aurora's mkinitcpio snippet (snd-seq in the initramfs) and the v2-preview link cleanup are not carried; see docs/parity/audio.md.
